$description: UBS Design System — Tone of Voice Tokens. Source: ubs.frontify.com

principles: Use bullet points for instructions (each starting with a verb)
Only say what you need to
Lead on the benefit to users, not the process
Remove empty adjectives (global, unique, robust, state-of-the-art)
Talk about what matters to readers first
See things from the reader's point of view
Draw readers in with an observation or intriguing headline
Create rhythm with repetition and mixed sentence lengths
Use natural-sounding phrases that paint pictures

traits.description: We are contemporary with purposeful intelligence
We inspire connections in the hands of our clients
We are always listening to clients' unique needs to realise their ambitions

messaging.principle: 1-2 punch: big catchy keyline + smaller informative infoline

rules.$description: Red highlighting in infoline/keyline no longer permitted for accessibility.
